frozen_measurement.regional_support: Omega=FOV & ~U; reuse frozen internal/near/far/ thin bundle. Do not recreate or alter hemorrhage dilation or thin skeleton for convenience.
frozen_measurement.point_target: T=stored thin & stored near; exactly 77 native target pixels in the 9 original valid images; other 19 images retain zero denominator and NA.
frozen_measurement.d1_hit: For target x, s(x)=max probability(q) over q in Omega with Euclidean distance(q,x)<=1. hit_d1=(s>=0.5), mathematically matching original distance-to-supported-prediction definition. The 5-pixel center/cross is valid; diagonal distance sqrt(2) is excluded.
frozen_measurement.direct_hit_vs_tolerated: Record center probability/hit separately. A center miss with d1_hit=true is already a matched target, not a primary FN.
frozen_measurement.exact_nearest_distance: Record Euclidean distance to PΩ empty support yields NA with reason, never an invented distance or gap. Nearest prediction need not be the same anatomical branch.
frozen_measurement.global_FP: FP=P & ~GT & FOV, including U as in original global metrics. This is relative to existing GT, not proof a structure is biologically false.
frozen_measurement.global_FN: FN=GT & FOV & ~P. Distinguish these pixel misses from d1 target misses.
frozen_measurement.global_denominator: FP/FOV uses all original FOV pixels, not the number of background pixels, and is not FPR.
frozen_measurement.NA: Preserve numerator, denominator, NA reason, fixed effective sets; no filling zero or pairwise dropping extra NA.
frozen_measurement.no_new_workpoint: No new threshold grid/ROC fitting, matching-FP threshold selection or radius search. Prior matched-FP review may be cited as already-completed context, clearly supplementary.

point_catalog_and_rows.source: Use the exact point_catalog and Dev order frozen in source_manifest.
point_catalog_and_rows.identity: point_id=filename:y{native_row}:x{native_col}; 0-based y/x. Within each image enumerate target pixels in row-major order; same identity in every condition.
point_catalog_and_rows.d1_witness_tie: Among equal maxima in the valid 5-pixel support choose lexicographically smallest (y,x); preserve the continuous score without rounding for decisions.
point_catalog_and_rows.score_band_limits: 0.45 is a prespecified descriptive margin boundary, informed by the completed review, not a new prediction threshold or performance criterion. Always store the exact score/margin; do not generate predictions at 0.45, claim probability calibration, infer image visibility from score alone, or adjust the band to improve the narrative.
point_catalog_and_rows.diagnostic_distance_features: Exact native distances/offsets and optional H/U/FOV boundary distances are descriptive. Empty H/U reference features must be NA with reason; never change evaluation masks or use an arbitrary additional spatial tolerance to turn a miss into a hit.
point_catalog_and_rows.paired_rows: Retain paired T0/TW observations within the same seed/point and method-specific 2000/4000 comparisons. Do not count the same target across conditions as independent target evidence.

computed_observations: Existing-label pixel FP/FN and frozen-d1 hit/miss
Continuous probability, signed 0.5 margin, prespecified descriptive score band
Native location, nearest supported prediction distance and witness
Per-image/method/seed recurring misses and observed paired changes
honesty_rules: Distances, missed-point clusters or disconnected predicted components alone do not confirm anatomical displacement or vessel breaks; nearby parallel vessels and crossings are alternatives.
Offset/break interpretations require the original RGB, GT and matched predictions with surrounding vessel context. A d1-tolerated offset must not be relabeled a primary miss.
Low score is not automatically low RGB visibility, and disagreement with GT is not automatically bad annotation.

AI visual observations are labeled AI-assisted suggestions even when visually supported. Never invent a human reviewer, expert signature or clinical confirmation. Actual identified researcher review is allowed; new dual-expert review is not required.
Multiple possible causes may coexist. Class frequencies are not forced to sum to 100%; report overlaps, unresolved cases and reviewed denominators.

Keep confirmed computed facts, visual evidence, causal hypotheses and unknowns in separate report sections. Do not infer gradient conflict, a loss mechanism, disease causality or topology improvement from these descriptive data.
error_evidence_taxonomy.coverage: Create 77 primary-point review cases and 28 whole-image FP review cases. Luna must actually inspect their image panels using available image-viewing capability, recording AI or actual human review honestly. Per-condition claims must identify which panels were viewed.
error_evidence_taxonomy.completion_limit: All 105 cases must have real AI-assisted or human visual review records for full Plan B visual delivery. Cause labels may remain uncertain. If image-viewing capability is unavailable, deliver quantitative outputs but explicitly mark the visual part incomplete; never mark all_passed or fabricate visual inspection to finish.
error_evidence_taxonomy.human_pending: Human adjudication can remain pending with explicit uncertainty; it does not prevent an engineering-complete AI-assisted analysis and is not to be represented as human-confirmed science.

FP_distribution.partition_rule: Reuse frozen internal/near/far masks partitioning Omega and add FOV&U. These four disjoint masks cover FOV; sum regional FP/FN/TP back to the global counts.
FP_distribution.components: Label the exact FP mask with fixed 8-connectivity. Retain every component regardless of size; record component ID, pixel area, native bbox/centroid and pixel counts in the four frozen regions. Components are label-relative error clusters, not confirmed false blood-vessel branches.
FP_distribution.component_identity: For each image/condition, label components deterministically by their smallest native (y,x); store library version. Do not match component IDs across methods as though they represent the same object.
FP_distribution.descriptive_features: Optionally record exact distance-to-GT and FP probability summaries to aid error interpretation; no component-size filter may alter the reported original FP counts.
FP_distribution.required_summaries: All per-image distributions, zero-FP cases, seed-specific and image-macro paired changes, adverse and favorable cases. No lesion-boundary/visibility stratum establishes a causal effect.

recurrence_and_statistics.formal_block: For each method and point, number of missed seeds among the three original seeds (0..3), all-three-missed flag, any-seed missed flag and between-seed disagreement. Count both T0->TW recoveries and losses within each paired seed.
recurrence_and_statistics.class_split_block: Report the same three-seed recurrence separately for 2/1; paired 2/1-T0 and 2/1-TW remain post-hoc exploratory.
recurrence_and_statistics.budget_block: For seed2026 only, report each method hit transitions, gained/lost positions, changes in image counts and (TW-T0)4000-(TW-T0)2000. Do not pool into formal three-seed aggregation.
recurrence_and_statistics.aggregation: Use per-image ratios and original macro means for method performance. Point counts and recurrence are descriptive and must not replace the frozen image-macro primary metric.
recurrence_and_statistics.intervals: When displaying paired performance intervals reproduce the original frozen per-image bootstrap: 1000 paired-image resamples, PCG64(20261016), fixed effective Dev order, same-n shared indices and linear [0.025,0.975] quantiles. No point-level p values or invented seed SD for single-seed supplements.
recurrence_and_statistics.required_reconciliation: Reproduce all original 7 metrics from the stored probabilities and verify them against each condition metrics.json. Preserve the completed formal/class-split/budget reports; any mismatch pauses related interpretation rather than silently changing the old result.
recurrence_and_statistics.cause_frequency_denominators: Report all-77 positions and all-28 images plus actual reviewed/assessable counts and per-condition coverage. Distinguish point-level, image-level and point-condition-level frequencies; 847 observations are repeated measurements of 77 targets, not 847 independent samples.

visualization_and_case_selection.all_image_atlas: All 28 images: RGB/GT and original-0.5 predictions/errors, with clear method/seed/step/phase labels and links to all 11 conditions; distinguish the formal six-condition block from both exploratory blocks.
visualization_and_case_selection.all_point_atlas: All 77 target positions: native RGB/GT and an 11-condition prediction/error montage with the target, 1-pixel matching support and scores labeled. Every target remains accessible, whether TP or FN.
visualization_and_case_selection.point_crop: 128x128 native-pixel display crop centered on the target, clipped at image borders; store exact [x0,y0,x1,y1] and provide full-image context. Display magnification is allowed but masks use nearest-neighbor display, not evaluation resampling.
visualization_and_case_selection.FP_crop: 256x256 native-pixel display crop centered on the selected component centroid, clipped at borders, with exact bbox and whole-image context. Display window sizes do not change lesion dilation or evaluation support.
representative_report_union: All three previously influential images: 20051205_35276_0400_PP, 20060411_61478_0200_PP, 20060530_54390_0100_PP. Explicitly disclose selection from prior review.
Top 3 primary-valid images by mean missed-primary fraction across the six formal conditions.
Image with lowest and image with highest original three-seed TW-T0 primary macro contribution; if no positive change exists do not label the highest as an improvement.
Top 3 images by mean FP/FOV across the six formal conditions, plus the largest positive and largest negative formal paired TW-T0 FP/FOV image changes.

One missed formal point closest below 0.5, one with lowest d1 score, and one with smallest finite nearest-prediction distance among d1 misses, each as a measurement-based illustrative case, not an automatically confirmed mechanism.
For selected FP-case images display the largest FP component in the lowest-seed formal T0 and TW conditions; no size filtering of quantitative counts.
visualization_and_case_selection.tie_breaking: Ties resolved by filename ascending, then native y/x, condition_id and component_id; deduplicate the union but retain every selection reason in case_selection.csv.
visualization_and_case_selection.visual_hypotheses: A visually suspected break/visibility limitation may be added to the report if the complete atlas reveals it; log the explicit qualitative selection reason and reviewer/evidence. It cannot replace the predetermined quantitative cases or be presented as representative prevalence.
visualization_and_case_selection.prohibited: No generative editing/inpainting, GT repair, selective cropping that hides context, undocumented contrast manipulation or outcome-driven omission. Scientific overlays are deterministic renderings of the actual source data.
visualization_and_case_selection.legend: Keep RGB and GT independently visible; include color legend for TP/FP/FN, H/near/U/FOV and target/d1 markers. Do not obscure a one-pixel target with a filled annotation marker.

structure_supervision_assessment.clDice: Evaluate whether visually supported and seed-repeated continuity errors are important enough to motivate topology/centerline precision-recall supervision. Distinguish this objective from the frozen local d1 recall; assess soft-skeleton iterations, masks/crop boundaries, annotation continuity, false bridges and compute overhead as potential risks.
structure_supervision_assessment.Skeleton_Recall_Loss: Evaluate whether persistent low-score reference skeleton misses are a relevant target, with the risk that an added recall term does not directly control background FP and tubed skeleton/mask choices may alter supervision. Preserve BCE/Dice and guardrail evidence; do not choose a new loss coefficient or implement it.
structure_supervision_assessment.decision_matrix: If evidence is mainly threshold-adjacent or reference/visibility-limited, do not present structure loss as a demonstrated solution. If repeated genuine missing segments are visually supported, propose a separately controlled future comparison rather than claiming efficacy from this analysis.
structure_supervision_assessment.literature: Read primary clDice/Skeleton Recall Loss papers and the critical 2025 SRL preprint; cite applicability and limitations, not cross-dataset gains as project evidence.
structure_supervision_assessment.future_authorization: Every new loss, model, training, dataset expansion, prediction forward pass or evaluation definition change requires explicit user approval.

Verify 77 frozen point IDs, original 9 image denominators, 19 NA states and Omega/d1 support.

CPU synthetic checks: probability exactly 0.5 included; d1 cross versus excluded diagonal; U/FOV exclusion; center miss but d1 hit; empty predictions/distances; NA zero denominators; region-partition sums; FP connectivity/zero-FP cases.
Check duplicate keys and fixed row counts; separate formal/class-split/budget blocks and paired seed/point identities; no pooled 4000-as-seed statistics.
Check native crop coordinates/legends/figure source identities and the 0.45 diagnostic-only band. Visual-review fields must preserve unreviewed/AI/human distinctions.
Inspect code paths to confirm no neural model construction/weights/forward/optimizer or official Test access; do not run training-based tests.
implementation_and_validation.binding: Create execution_binding.json and reuse_manifest.json before substantive analysis; store source hashes, environment/library versions and validation evidence. New implementation changes require affected checks to be rerun with a new binding, retaining failed attempts.
implementation_and_validation.validation_artifact: validation/verification.json with true checks, evidence paths, protocol/source/execution binding hashes and all_passed only if actually satisfied
final_checks: Recompute all original 7 fixed-0.5 metrics for all 11 conditions from stored predictions and compare to stored per-image counts/aggregates, including 77 position counts and NA.
Verify each FP component pixel area sums to its original FP mask and all four region counts sum to FOV counts.
Verify full CSV coverage/unique keys, per-point recurrence and all paired cross-seed/method/temporal relations.
Verify all 105 actual visual review cases, figure links/native bbox records, explicit evidence-level labels and unresolved categories.
Verify formal negative/class-split/budget conclusions not rewritten; all protected files unchanged; zero training/inference and no Test access.
Produce real completion_verification.json and report only after these checks, with exact counts from manifests, not hardcoded subtract-one counters.
implementation_and_validation.failure: Missing/corrupt/misbound saved predictions or changed definitions stop the affected analysis and are reported. Do not regenerate predictions, drop cases or silently substitute checkpoints. Routine same-scope implementation fixes are authorized; changes to scientific definitions/data scope or new experiments return to the user.

acceptance.success_is_not_positive_method_result: A negative, mixed or unresolved mechanism finding is a valid scientific output. Honest incomplete visual inspection must be marked incomplete rather than fabricated.
acceptance.handoff: Luna updates existing STATUS with real code, validation, quantitative/visual findings, evidence paths and unresolved issues. Then stop and hand to Sol for scientific review; do not autonomously start structural-loss experiments.
